headline: Musk and tech executives petition Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang
summary: Elon Musk and other tech executives signed a petition or open letter urging Nvidia's board to reinstate ousted CEO Jensen Huang. Outlets reported differing signature totals at different points as the petition grew, and the Guardian said Huang himself is reportedly already plotting a return.
